Park: 49.89629, -115.14141, pull off on Bull River FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 4.1 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 47 m, about 87 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-22, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
F-moose-walk-0021.recDirections: Commencing at the Fort Steele Historic Park, proceed north on Hwy 93/95 for 300 metres. Turn right onto the Wardner - Ft. Steele Road. Follow this road for 22 km to the Power Plant Road. Turn left onto this road and follow it over the Bull River Canyon. On the east side of the river, you will find yourself at the 22 km road marker on the Bull River FSR. Turn left and continue following the Bull River FSR to Norboe Creek which is between the 74 km and 75 km markers. The Norboe Creek Recreation Site is on the south side of the creek.
